name: Tool Tracer
description: On-demand tool/action trace for Copilot Studio runs (`/special-debug tool-trace` → `tool_trace.json`).
author: Rafael Lopez Alcaraz
coverImageAlt: A cyan tool path branches around a plain orange interruption and rejoins before reaching a clear audit crystal.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: an invisible sequence of tool actions becomes a precise, inspectable trace showing order, branching, retry, and outcome without exposing sensitive contents
Scene/backdrop: a dark slate instrument bench with transparent layered channels illuminated from beneath
Subject: a single cyan path travels through a sequence of tactile mechanical nodes, briefly branches around a plain solid orange mechanical interruption with no symbol or marking, rejoins, and terminates in a clear audit crystal
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; readable left-to-right sequence and strong silhouette at card size
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; controlled cyan backlighting with one sparing orange fault accent
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: the orange interruption must be an unmarked solid geometric object with no warning icon, punctuation, glyph, or symbol; no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
